topic.title: If Statement Practice
topic.description: Checks height and age for a rollercoaster ride, calculates ticket price, and offers a photo add-on. A practical multi-condition exercise.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Nested if-elif-else statements and building a bill by accumulating costs conditionally.
learningNotes.challenges: Correctly nesting conditions and keeping track of the running bill variable.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add more ride types and group discount logic.
